bundle.shortDescription: Post-quantum zero-knowledge password vault with multi-S3 sync
bundle.longDescription: Password, TOTP, secure note and encrypted media manager with hybrid post-quantum encryption (ML-KEM-1024 + X25519, Argon2id, XChaCha20-Poly1305). Works offline and syncs, sealed, directly from your device to one or several S3-compatible buckets (a master plus mirrors), with restore into a new vault.
